text: Great first date. No text. This is a story from a woman. So 24 years old female and 26 years old male. First of all, I'm 90% sure that I'm overthinking this but my anxiety and fear of rejection is telling me otherwise. I, 24 years old male, have been speaking to a guy, 26 years old male, for a while and tonight was our first date. He took me out for dinner. The whole night was amazing. We have good chemistry and get along so well. There wasn't a second of awkward silence between us. I think I'm starting to catch feelings for him, which is crazy because I've turned into a man-hater since my ex. He dropped me off home around 10 30 p.m. And we were just cuddling in his car and then he kissed me. Was telling me how pretty dreamy I am. He has to be up for work at 5 a.m. I messaged him after he dropped me off, but he didn't text me back. The reasonable thing to think is that he didn't respond because he went straight to bed. But my brain is convincing me that I'm being ghosted. Thoughts? Okay, I want to start by saying this. This is a story from a woman and why I'm showing it here is for guys to understand. Women have insecurities too. If she liked you and liked the date, she's waiting for your text. Not every woman will overthink like this one, but here's the point. If a girl ignores you, doesn't return your messages, she is not interested. But if she is interested, she will wait for your text and she will want to meet with you. That's why it's important to focus on women who like you back. When the interest is mutual, things go much smoother. Now about this story. Whether you're a man or a woman, don't get obsessed right after the date. You don't even know the person that well. Go live your life. Stay busy. In this case, the guy might be asleep. He might be also busy and that's normal. The simple rule is this. Give it a couple of days. If he's interested, he will text you and invite you again. If not, don't beg. Don't double or triple text. Just move on. There are plenty of guys out there. And additional piece of advice for the guys. The guy in this story actually did a lot right. Made her comfortable, kissed her. She clearly liked him. But guys, if she's giving you green lights like that, at least try to take her back to your place. Even if you have work at 5 a.m, come on, you can handle one night of less sleep. Sometimes life can be more cruel and if you don't act when the opportunity is right, the girl loses interest because she thinks you are too slow. Alright, hope you like the answer. Thanks and bye.
